basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Driver Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Driver post in the Kalyana Karnataka residual cadre of the courts of Kalaburagi district is open to general candidates who have passed the 10th standard or an equivalent examination and hold a current heavy vehicles driving licence, with a pay scale of Rs 34100-67600 plus other allowances. The Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಜಿಲ್ಲಾ ಮತ್ತು ಸತ್ರ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಧೀಶರ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯ, ಕಲಬುರಗಿ) accepts applications online only, through the link on kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in, from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026 (11.59 PM), and the fee can be paid until 17 December 2026.

age_limit.details: Age is counted as on the last date fixed for receiving applications. A candidate must have completed 18 years and must not exceed the maximum age given below. | Category Maximum Age General Not more than 35+5* years Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B Not more than 38+5* years Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribe / Category-1 Not more than 40+5* years | The added 5 years (marked *) come from Government Order No. CASU 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, which gives a one-time (as a one time measure) relaxation of 5 years in the maximum age to candidates of all categories in direct recruitment notifications issued up to 31.12.2027.

qualification.details: For the Driver post, a candidate must have passed the 10th standard or an equivalent examination and must hold a current heavy vehicles driving licence by the last date fixed for receiving applications. The vacancy is shown in the notice under the General candidate category (Others). Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online, through the link given on the Kalaburagi district court website https://kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/, from 16 November 2026 until 11.59 PM on 15 December 2026. The steps and conditions printed in the notice are:
Read all the instructions before filling the online application; an incorrect application will be rejected.
Enter a mobile number (compulsory) and an email ID if you have one. The court is not responsible if an SMS or email does not reach you.
Upload a recent colour photograph of 5 cm height x 3.6 cm width and 50 KB size, with a light-coloured background, preferably white.
Sign with a black ballpoint pen on white paper, scan it and upload it; do not sign on the photograph.
Enter the SSLC / 2nd PUC maximum marks, marks obtained and total percentage in the column given; if grades or CGPA were awarded, convert them into marks.
Fill in all the details asked for and pay the fee as shown in the application by 17 December 2026.
Download the application and the challan copy of the fee paid, and keep them until the recruitment process is over.

The fee is paid through the link on the court website by online payment through net banking, credit card, debit card or UPI. Challan, demand draft, postal order or money order are not accepted. The notice also says the fee is to be paid by 17 December 2026 within the transaction hours of State Bank of India branches. An application without the fee will be rejected, and a fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances.
Copy of the SBI e-pay receipt of the fee paid for the post
SSLC marks card / transfer certificate / cumulative record documents to verify the date of birth
Conduct certificates from two respectable persons, issued within 6 months from the date fixed for sending the application, and a school conduct certificate
No Objection Certificate (for candidates in government service)

All certificates, including reservation certificates, must be obtained in the prescribed formats from the authority concerned by the last date, and the originals must be produced at verification. Certificates in other formats, or obtained after the last date (except the Kannada medium study certificate), will not be considered, and the reservation or candidature may be cancelled.
important_instructions: In-service candidates must apply online within the date and time fixed and must hold a No Objection Certificate issued by the authority concerned. A candidate found to be impersonating, submitting false or tampered documents, making false statements, hiding facts or using unfair means will face criminal and disciplinary action, and the candidature will be cancelled. Applying online and qualifying in the test does not give any right to appointment; appointment is subject to the eligibility criteria fixed by the Government from time to time. Where any rule or procedure is unclear, the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977, the Karnataka Civil Services (Direct Recruitment) (General) Rules, 2021, the related Government Orders and the judicial department's cadre and recruitment rules apply. Candidates are not allowed to correspond with the office about this recruitment. For information, the office phone number is 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM).

content_sections.heading: About Kalaburagi District Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi, and is signed by G. L. Lakshminarayana, Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi. The post is a direct recruitment to the Driver post in the Kalyana Karnataka residual cadre (ಮಿಕ್ಕುಳಿದ ವೃಂದ) of the courts in Kalaburagi district, made under the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Ministerial and Other Posts) (Recruitment) Rules, 1982 and its amendment rules of 2007 and 2021.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: For the Driver post, a candidate must have passed the 10th standard or an equivalent examination and must hold a current heavy vehicles driving licence by the last date fixed for receiving applications. The vacancy is shown in the notice under the General candidate category (Others). Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. Age is counted as on the last date fixed for receiving applications. A candidate must have completed 18 years and must not exceed the maximum age given below. The added 5 years (marked *) come from Government Order No. CASU 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, which gives a one-time (as a one time measure) relaxation of 5 years in the maximum age to candidates of all categories in direct recruitment notifications issued up to 31.12.2027.

rows.category: Holding or held a post in the Karnataka State Government, a local authority, or a corporation set up by a State or Central Act and owned or controlled by the Karnataka Government
rows.relaxation: Years of service in the post or 10 years, whichever is less
Years of service in the armed forces plus 3 years

rows.category: Holding or held a post in the Government of India Census organisation in Karnataka
rows.relaxation: Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less

rows.category: Released full-time cadet instructors of the National Cadet Corps
Village group trainers appointed under the State Government's rural industrialisation scheme (working or earlier)
rows.relaxation: Years served as village group trainer

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Driver post carries the pay scale 34100-800-35700-900-39300-1000-43300-1125-47800-1250-52800-1375-58300-1500-64300-1650-67600 and other allowances. The notice does not list the allowances separately. Selected candidates will be on probation for 2 years under the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977. During probation they must pass the departmental examinations prescribed for the post and the Kannada language examination.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is by direct recruitment under the Karnataka Subordinate Courts (Ministerial and Other Posts) (Recruitment) Rules, 1982 and (Amendment) Rules, 2007. The notice states that, on the basis of the total percentage of marks in the driving qualifying test, the highest-scoring candidates in the ratio of 1:25 per post will be called for the qualifying test and interview, and selection will be made on the basis of the marks obtained in the interview. Driving qualifying test: 50 marks Interview: 10 marks Information will be sent to eligible candidates by SMS and email. The list of candidates eligible for the interview will be published on the court website, and candidates must download it and produce it when they appear for the interview. The date and venue of the test and interview are not specified in the notice.
